newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular unit gets Mexican contract.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular unit gets Mexican contract.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said Wednesday Norcom Resources Inc, a subsidiary of its 80 percent owned Universal Commodities Corp, has signed a multi-phase $600,000 contract with Bancrecer of Mexico, one of Mexico's largest banks.

"Our group is expecting a substantial increase in revenues and earnings for 1997 and 1998 as a result of this transaction and other similar contracts," Marc Sherman, chief executive of Universal Commodities Corp and Applied Cellular's Computer Group, said in a news release. "Further, we expect our combined group, which includes Universal Commodities, Norcom Resources, Pizzaro Re- Marketing, and Elite Computers to contribute over $50 million in revenues to Applied Cellular for the calendar 1997 year."

The first phase of this contract is $600,000 with COS Computer Systems Inc to provide data center maintenance and consulting services to Bancrecer of Mexico, the company said, adding that the total contract is estimated to exceed $1 million over the coming year.
Applied Technology had sales and revneues of $19.9 million in 1996, the company said.
Applied Technology shares rose 3/16 to 3-1/4 Wednesday.
